# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)</sub>; Miss Penrose  <sub>[v2 c21 P32](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0032), [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Rosalind is a tiny woman with an almost youthful face featuring dimples, rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and large, gentle brown eyes with gold flecks. She has thick, wavy, snow-white hair styled in puffs and coils. She wears delicate cream muslin dresses patterned with light-colored roses.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)_

## Personality

Miss Rosalind is a deeply imaginative, romantic, and warm-hearted solitary woman who loves society and young company. Although considered peculiar by some locals for her imaginative habits and isolated lifestyle, she possesses a delightful, youthful spirit and a gentle voice.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P32](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0032), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- Hospitable  <sub>[v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- Fond of young girls  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

## Abilities

- Imagining social tea parties and companions  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

## Goals

- To escape solitude through imaginative pretenses and hosting visitors  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P78](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0078)</sub>

## History

Rosalind Penrose grew up in an isolated stone dwelling near Welby and Brierley. In her youth, she was engaged to Stephen Stanhope, but after a disagreement twenty-five years ago, the engagement ended and Stephen left for the United States. She subsequently withdrew from public life, living quietly in her ivy-covered sandstone dwelling. To cope with her isolation, she frequently indulged in imaginative games, such as dressing up and preparing elaborate tea parties for imaginary guests with her handmaiden, Belinda the Fourth. When Nell and Isolde strayed into her garden while looking for directions, she enthusiastically invited them to join her tea party and quickly bonded with Nell over their shared love of imagining things. Upon hearing about Cedric Stanhope, Stephen's son, she inquired about him and fell into quiet contemplation after her guests departed.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c21 P47](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0047), [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P56](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0056), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c21 P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084), [v2 c21 P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of an English settler who built her sandstone house eight decades prior  <sub>[v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007)</sub>
- Named Rosalind after her father's love for her mother's lavender-scented sheets  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Engaged twenty-five years ago to Stephen Stanhope before a sudden disagreement separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> I am not awaiting anyone . . . I was merely imagining that I was. You understand, I felt very isolated.  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)</sub>

> Occasionally, I doubt I could survive without imagining things.  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

> Does Stephen Stanhope claim him as a son?  <sub>[v2 c21 P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)</sub>
